title: Constitutive State-Space Modeling of Path-Dependent Plasticity: A Resolution-Consistent and Parallelizable Computational Framework
abstract: arXiv:2609.07294v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Data-driven constitutive models for path-dependent plasticity are commonly formulated using nonlinear recurrent neural networks, whose sequential state evolution limits parallel training and whose predictions may depend on the discretization of the applied strain path. We introduce a Constitutive State Space (CSS) model that reformulates structured state-space dynamics as an incremental constitutive operator. The strain increment is decomposed into magnitude and direction: the loading direction drives the latent state-space system, while the increment magnitude enters the zero-order-hold discretization of its continuous-time linear recurrence. This mechanics-tailored construction guarantees stationarity under zero increments, strongly reduces sensitivity to strain-path resolution, and retains the parallel-scan structure of S5 for efficient training on long constitutive histories. translated_title: 路径依赖塑性的本构状态空间建模：一种分辨率一致且可并行化的计算框架
translated_abstract: 针对路径依赖塑性的数据驱动本构模型通常采用非线性循环神经网络来构建，其顺序状态演化限制了并行训练，且预测结果可能依赖于所施加应变路径的离散化方式。我们提出了一种本构状态空间（CSS）模型，将结构化状态空间动力学重新表述为增量本构算子。应变增量被分解为幅值和方向两部分：加载方向驱动潜在状态空间系统，而增量幅值则进入其连续时间线性递推的零阶保持离散化。这种为力学特性量身定制的构造保证了零增量下的平稳性，显著降低了对应变路径分辨率的敏感性，并保留了S5的并行扫描结构，从而能够在长本构历史序列上进行高效训练。CSS和最小状态单元（MSC）架构……
tldr: 本文提出一种本构状态空间（CSS）模型，通过将应变增量分解为方向与幅值并嵌入结构化状态空间动力学，实现了路径依赖塑性建模中对应变路径分辨率的一致性，同时保留并行扫描结构以支持长本构历史的高效训练。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces a Constitutive State Space (CSS) model that reformulates structured state-space dynamics as an incremental constitutive operator by decomposing strain increments into direction and magnitude, achieving resolution-consistent and parallelizable modeling of path-dependent plasticity.
